title: 第七章 季军师第八章 洪元帅与季军师一
content_zh:
李言边随队伍向前移动，边思量着事情。
“看台上洪元帅向这边关注的神情，这帐篷之内也许不光是登名造册那么简单，难道还有别的什么考核不成？
只是这帐篷看起来并不是很大的样子，施展拳脚却是有些小了，莫非这军中也要考量文采么？”
李言可是没听国新叔说还要参加文试的，但即便是参加文试，也应该许多人同时进行才是，眼前的小帐篷就难以解释了。
就这样，他低着头边走边思量间，突然觉得眼前一亮，原来他前方最后一人已走入帐篷，此时前方已是空阔一片了。
只是当李言抬起头来时，前方那人已进入落下了门帘，他却没有看清里面的情形了。
于是，李言就收敛了心思不再多想，待在原地静静的等候。
待得过了约莫三十息之后，便有人挑帘走了出来，正是刚才那入内的青年。
此时这人一手正在撸下另一只手腕上的衣袖，脸上却充满了迷茫，一幅大惑不解的样子。
而后在门旁军卒催促下，他也只得快步走向了校场中间那排队伍的末尾处了，这时军卒中的一人用手指向李言。
“你，进去吧！”
李言听罢，在心中忐忑中也依言向帐篷门处走去。
挑开门帘进入帐篷，李言只觉得眼前一暗，他稍微闭了闭双眼，适应了下光线后，再次睁开双眼时，他才看清帐篷内的景物。
里面只有一张矮桌，桌后一人盘膝坐在一块不大的地毯上，此人年约四十左右，头戴文士冠。
他身着宽松黑袍，黑袍下摆铺散于地，笼罩其下半身，即使坐着也只比李言矮上少许的样子，想来身材也是极高。
文士脸瘦而狭长，面色青灰，一缕长须飘洒胸前，一双手拢在袖中环抱胸腹之前，被矮桌半遮着，一双细眼开阖间偶有一缕精芒射出，此时正打量着李言。
看见李言望向自己，黑袍文士从袖中伸出一只修长白皙手指，一指桌前一块不大的地毯。
“坐！”
然后就不再多言，静待李言过来。
此时的李言别人说什么，当然就是什么，他依言几步就走到了桌前。

他才发现桌面上放置了一个展开的淡黄色布囊，布囊由竖缝着一排排小袋子组成，袋口朝上，每个小袋里面插着数量不等的细针，露出袋口的针尾银光闪耀。
李言看着这桌上一排排发着寒光的银针，心中不免打起鼓来，心想。
“这里没有笔墨纸砚，怎么登记造册了？却何故摆了这件物什，到底是何用处？”
一时间，顿时心中七上八下起来，不知如何去做才是。
那黑袍人看到李言来到桌前盯着银针犹豫不决，并未坐下，于是再次开口。
“放心，只是给你做下经脉测试，如果经脉甚好，说不得便有一番造化等着你了。”
李言听罢此话后，心中虽然不明对方说的什么，但也不能再有犹豫了，于是便也像桌后黑袍人一样盘腿坐了下来。
他来也是来到这里了，无论如何都要经过这关，否则根本无法进入下一关校场考核的，想得再多也是无用。
黑袍人看到李言坐下后，这才微微一笑。
“把你左手腕衣袖卷起，露出手腕放在桌上即可，几息便好。”
李言不再多想，伸出右手把左手腕部的粗布衣袖向上卷起一截，然后手心向上，就放在桌面布囊一侧。
黑袍人见李言依言把左手放好后，他也伸出右手，用两根白皙修长的手指从那展开的一个布袋中，闪电般拈起一枚银针。
在李言看清之前，李言只觉手腕一麻，待细看时，那枚银针已是大半没入了自己手腕处经脉之中。
黑袍人做罢这件事后，双手已然重新收回袖中，又是双手环抱于袖低垂于自己的腹前，然后扫眼看着李言面部。
李言觉得手腕部一麻后，便再没有什么其他异样感觉了。
但是就在他疑惑之际，仅仅两个呼吸后，他顿觉腹部一股凉气直升脑部，脑袋顿感一凉，浑身有种舒爽之觉。
黑袍人本来细瞇着双眼，看李言一脸无恙，心中已微觉可惜。
这种情况这些年中不知见过多少次了，只是每次下针之后他的心中总还是存着那一份期待罢了。
几年中只有去年年初那次让他欣喜若狂，只可惜最终结果却令他十分愤怒。
眼见对方除了一脸的疑惑，并没有什么其他反应，心中微叹。

就在黑袍文士打算从李言脉门之上取出银针之时，却看见李言脸上慢慢涌出了一层黑气，黑袍文士先是一愣，旋即心中大喜。
只是脸上却依旧保持平静，随即双手出手如风，如穿蝴蝶般的飞舞，又是四枚银针没入李言脉门之中。
这次仅仅是一息之后，李言顿时觉得又有四股热、燥、重、温之气自腹部升起，直冲顶门。
content_en:
Li Yan thought about things while moving forward with the team.
"Marshal Hong's concerned look in the stands, it may be that there is more to the tent than just signing up and making a list. Is there any other assessment?
It's just that this tent doesn't look very big, but it's a bit small for showing off. Does this army also have to consider literary talent? "
Li Yan didn't hear Uncle Guo Xin say that he had to take the literary test, but even if he took the literary test, many people should take it at the same time. The small tent in front of him was difficult to explain.
Just like that, while he was walking and thinking with his head down, he suddenly felt his eyes light up. It turned out that the last person in front of him had entered the tent, and now the front was empty.
But when Li Yan raised his head, the man in front had already entered and lowered the door curtain, but he could not see clearly what was going on inside.
As a result, Li Yan calmed down and stopped thinking more, staying where he was and waiting quietly.
After waiting for about thirty breaths, someone came out through the curtain. It was the young man who had entered just now.
At this time, the man was rolling down the sleeve of his other wrist with one hand, but his face was full of confusion, with a look of great confusion.
Then, under the urging of the soldiers at the door, he had no choice but to quickly walk to the end of the line in the middle of the school field. At this time, one of the soldiers pointed at Li Yan.
"You, go in!"
After hearing this, Li Yan followed the instructions and walked towards the tent door with anxiety in his heart.
Li Yan opened the door curtain and entered the tent. Li Yan felt that his eyes were dark. He closed his eyes for a while, and after adjusting to the light, when he opened his eyes again, he could clearly see the scenery inside the tent.
There was only a low table inside, and behind the table sat a person sitting cross-legged on a small carpet. The man was about forty years old and wore a scribe's crown.
He was wearing a loose black robe, with the hem of the black robe spread on the ground, covering his lower body. Even when sitting, he was only slightly shorter than Li Yan, and he was still very tall.
The scribe's face was thin and narrow, with a blue-gray complexion. A long beard spread across his chest. His hands were folded in his sleeves and hugged his chest and abdomen, half covered by the low table. A ray of light occasionally shot out from his pair of slender eyes. He was looking at Li Yan at this time.
Seeing Li Yan looking at him, the black-robed scribe stretched out a slender white finger from his sleeve and pointed at a small carpet in front of the table.
"Sit!"
Then he stopped talking and waited for Li Yan to come over.
At this time, Li said that of course it was what others said. He followed the words and walked to the table in a few steps.
Only then did he realize that there was an unfolded light yellow cloth bag placed on the table. The cloth bag was composed of rows of small bags sewn vertically, with the mouth of the bag facing upward. There were a varying number of fine needles inserted in each small bag, and the needle tails exposed at the mouth of the bag shone with silver light.
Li Yan looked at the rows of silver needles glowing coldly on the table and thought to himself.
"There are no pens, inks, paper and inkstones here. How come they are registered? Why are these things placed here? What is their purpose?"
For a moment, my heart suddenly became anxious and I didn't know what to do.
The man in black robe saw Li Yan coming to the table, staring at the silver needle and hesitating, without sitting down, so he spoke again.
"Don't worry, I'm just doing a meridians test on you. If your meridians are very good, there may be some good fortune waiting for you."
After hearing this, Li Yan felt that although he didn't know what the other party said, he could no longer hesitate, so he sat down cross-legged like the man in black robe behind the table.
He came here because he had to pass this level no matter what, otherwise he would not be able to enter the next level of the school assessment. No matter how much he thought about it, it would be useless.
The man in black robe smiled slightly when he saw Li Yan sitting down.
"Roll up your left wrist sleeve, expose your wrist and place it on the table. It will take a few breaths."
Li Yan stopped thinking about it and stretched out his right hand to roll up the coarse cloth sleeve on his left wrist, then put his palm up on the side of the cloth bag on the table.
After the man in black robe saw Li Yan put his left hand as instructed, he also stretched out his right hand and used both hands toA long white finger picked up a silver needle from the unfolded cloth bag like lightning.
Before Li Yan could see clearly, Li Yan only felt a numbness in his wrist. When he took a closer look, most of the silver needle had already sunk into the meridians of his wrist.
After the man in black robe finished doing this, he put his hands back into his sleeves, hugged the sleeves and hung down on his belly, and then glanced at Li Yan's face.
After Li Yan felt his wrist go numb, there was no other strange feeling anymore.
But just when he was doubtful, after just two breaths, he suddenly felt a cold air rising from his abdomen to his brain, his head suddenly felt cold, and he felt a sense of relief all over his body.
The man in black robes squinted his eyes carefully and felt a little pity in his heart when he saw that Li Yan's face was fine.
He had seen this situation countless times over the years, but he still had that expectation in his heart after each injection.
In the past few years, only the time at the beginning of last year made him ecstatic, but unfortunately the final result made him very angry.
Seeing that the other party had no other reaction besides a look of confusion, I sighed in my heart.
Just when the black-robed scribe was about to take out the silver needle from Li Yan's pulse gate, he saw a layer of black energy slowly coming out of Li Yan's face. The black-robed scribe was stunned at first, and then he was overjoyed.
But his face remained calm, and then his hands flew like the wind, flying like butterflies, and four more silver needles sank into Li Yan's vein gate.
After just one breath this time, Li Yan suddenly felt four more waves of hot, dry, heavy, and warm air rising from his abdomen and heading straight for the top door.
